title: JetBrains warns of critical TeamCity remote code execution flaw
summary: JetBrains is warning of a critical authentication bypass vulnerability affecting TeamCity On-Premises that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution. JetBrains notes that TeamCity 2024.03 and newer automatically downloads available security patch plugins and notifies administrators so they can install them.
